item.title: Tonale 1.0.1
item.description:
Tonale 1.0.1 (11)
- Local audio and video now share one Local Media page and one Files & Folders window. - Use All, Audio and Video filters in Local Media and Apple Music; Tonale remembers your selections. - Add mixed files and folders in one step, with one import report. Rescan or reconnect selected sources together. - Browse large local libraries faster, with improved search, sorting and missing-file filtering. - Smoother Apple Music filter changes and improved playlist layouts, window sizing and list columns.

item.title: Tonale 1.0.1
item.description:
Saved YouTube playlists now sync across your Tonale account.
- Restore saved playlist links on another Mac using that Mac's permitted YouTube access. - Keep imported titles and cached videos on each Mac while syncing playlist references and your custom labels. - Repair previously skipped playlists automatically, with safer handling of interrupted sync and conflicts. - Keep playlists under On This Mac local until you choose to copy them to your synced library.

item.title: Tonale 1.0.1
item.description:
Tonale 1.0.1 (9)
- Speaker Simulation now follows local audio and video, YouTube inside Tonale, Apple Music songs, and videos played through Music in the Direct edition. - Keep video in a separate window with its own pin, size modes, and controls and queue in another window. - Queue headings show the playlist or source name. Playback changes and local-source navigation avoid unnecessary layout flashes. - Improved Music video window handling and Apple Music media icons. - Refined YouTube settings, sign-in status, and the resizable account window. - Improved local-source consistency and duplicate management, including choosing which copy to keep. - About and update dialogs now display the build number.

item.title: Tonale 1.0.1
item.description:
Tonale 1.0.1 (8)
- Clarifies YouTube account connection and playlist import settings. - Groups YouTube import, playback and stored-data settings more clearly. - Marks player sign-in as optional and explains when it is needed, with updated translations.

item.title: Tonale 1.0.1
item.description: - Connect your YouTube account to import your own playlists, including private and unlisted ones, and your Liked Videos. Tonale asks Google for read-only access and never changes anything on YouTube. - Imported playlists stay up to date by themselves. Disconnect removes them from this Mac and from your synced library. - Updated translations in all 25 languages.

item.title: Tonale 1.0.1
item.description:
## Tonale 1.0.1 (build 6)
- **Watch on YouTube.** When the player inside Tonale cannot play a YouTube video, choose Watch on YouTube (also in the Playback menu). Tonale shows YouTube's own page for the video in a Tonale window; your queue waits, and Next goes on. - **Sign in to YouTube on every macOS version.** On macOS 27 or later the player inside Tonale uses your YouTube account; on earlier versions your sign-in is used on YouTube's page in the Watch on YouTube window. - The sign-in and Watch on YouTube windows show only YouTube and Google's sign-in pages; everything else opens in your browser.

item.title: Tonale 1.0.1
item.description:
## Tonale 1.0.1 (build 5)
- **Sign in to YouTube (macOS 27 or later).** In Settings › YouTube, Sign in to YouTube… lets videos in Tonale play with your YouTube account. This helps when YouTube asks you to sign in to confirm you're not a bot. It is optional, and Sign Out… deletes YouTube's website data from Tonale. - **Clearer YouTube problems.** When YouTube does not play a video, the queue pauses and says why instead of waiting silently. Age-restricted videos are marked before they play, and links in the YouTube player open in your browser. - **Apple Music videos.** Music videos from your Apple Music library play in Tonale, and streamed Apple Music videos play in the Music app, in a window. - **Library.** Double-click plays the row right away, then fills the queue; a row that cannot play says why. Local Audio and Local Video folders are watched and rescanned by themselves. - Every pending string is translated.

item.title: Tonale 1.0.1
item.description:
## Tonale 1.0.1 (build 4)
- **Clearer menus and dialogs.** Risky actions are red and set apart, delete confirmations say what is removed and how much, and dialogs name the item they act on. - **New commands.** File ▸ New Playlist…, Edit ▸ Find… (⌘F), View ▸ Show/Hide Sidebar (⌃⌘S) and Playback ▸ Play/Pause, Next and Previous. Audio Player and Video Player are now in the Window menu. - **YouTube.** Videos without a title show a notice with Reload Titles and Durations, and titles are filled in when public YouTube requests are allowed. A YouTube problem no longer blocks the rest of the library. - **Local files.** Local Video lists the videos already in your library, Get Info shows a file's details, and "could not open" notices name the file. - **Players.** Easier-to-read controls, a queue summary, and Play in Audio Player for files that have no picture. Audio Effects says which output its settings are for. - **Settings and account.** Every pane explains what its buttons remove, Account & Sync matches the other panes, and the sidebar shows the sync state. Contact Support on the account screen works again. - Consent, privacy and deletion text is now translated into every supported language.

item.title: Tonale 1.0.1
item.description:
## Tonale 1.0.1
- **Sync no longer stalls on larger uploads.** A batch of many changes was refused by the server and then shown as "waiting to upload" forever. Refused changes are now tried again from your library, and the few that still cannot be uploaded are shown as such. - Local files whose tags are empty sync cleanly.

item.title: Tonale 1.0.0
item.description:
## Tonale 1.0.0
- **Xin Account and sync.** Sign in with an email code, a password, Apple or Google, and keep your playlists and saved filters in sync across Macs. Signing in also signs in XHelpers Pro on the same Mac. - **Local files are recognized by content.** A moved or renamed file, or the same file on another Mac, stays connected to its playlists. - **Find Missing Files…** reconnects files that moved, and **Find Duplicates…** merges copies of the same file. - **Files & Folders** replaces "Folders" for local audio and video sources, and adding a folder now imports both its audio and its video. - **Add from YouTube…** takes video and playlist links in one sheet. - **Settings** has a sidebar with a pane for each source and for Account & Sync. - Clearer empty pages, brighter sidebar items, correct one-item wording ("1 song", not "1 songs"), and Tab moves between sign-in fields.
